d:
Double feature comic!

1st story is about Jemnemzy from Final Fantasy VII - with her revamped, much better look from the FFMobius card game.

2nd story is about Zephyrus from FFV and Alluring Rider from FFVI, who look very alike but are two distinct entities, the story reinvents who both are.

Has one extra, E-Hentai exclusive post-story soft-vore artwork feauring Alluring Rider and Zephyrus - my usual way to justify the use of the "female:vore tag, so that the comic gets read by users here.

If interested about reading my and others comics, you can go here:
https://storinex.com/creator/ddark92
